symptom: The first homepage availability rail could collapse to one tab, and long search result sets could remain at six visible cards.
expected_behavior: Every configured homepage period remains selectable and owns its own loading state; an in-view progressive result sentinel continues from 6 to 15 to the complete result count.
environment: Public release 596 at vii.spaplus.co and release candidate source on 2026-10-23.

steps: Open the homepage while only one home-deal cache period has an accepted snapshot.
Open a location search with at least 18 results and keep the continuation sentinel in view.
reproduction.evidence: Release 596 returned display.periods filtered by availablePeriods, and the public QA report recorded searches remaining at 6 of 18 and 6 of 48.

observations.observation: The home-deals route filtered configured tabs against prepared cache snapshots and substituted another period when the requested snapshot was missing.
observations.evidence: Pre-fix app/api/vii/home-deals/route.ts used availablePeriods and selected fallback snapshots.

observations.observation: ProgressiveResults kept a 180 ms loading lock while its observer was disconnected and recreated, so an already-visible sentinel did not necessarily emit another intersection event.
observations.evidence: Pre-fix app/components/progressive-results.tsx used loadingRef with a timer inside an observer whose dependencies changed after each controlled increment.

hypotheses.mechanism: Server-side cache availability was incorrectly treated as homepage tab configuration.
hypotheses.prediction: A partial cache leaves only its accepted periods in display.periods and can label fallback data as the requested selection.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Execute the actual route with only a weekend snapshot while requesting tomorrow.
hypotheses.result: The old contract returned only weekend; the repaired route keeps all configured tabs, returns tomorrow as refreshing and never substitutes weekend data.

hypotheses.mechanism: The client initially defined only one homepage period.
hypotheses.prediction: The first client render would contain one period before any API response.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect the HomeLiveDeals initial state and render the local candidate with unavailable supplier APIs.
hypotheses.result: The client initializes all five periods and the candidate retained five tabs even when every local supplier request returned 503.

hypotheses.mechanism: A timer-based observer lock loses the next controlled continuation while the sentinel remains visible.
hypotheses.prediction: The parent count increases once but no later observer event occurs until the sentinel leaves and re-enters the viewport.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Trace the effect dependencies and replace the timer with sentinel visibility plus a last-requested-count guard.
hypotheses.result: The new contract requests once for every new controlled visible count and prevents loops when the parent count does not advance.

fix.change: Return configured periods unchanged, load only the requested period, expose an honest refreshing state, and drive progressive continuation from persistent sentinel visibility and the last completed count.
fix.evidence: Targeted route and progression tests pass; local desktop and mobile QA show five homepage tabs, no stuck busy state and no stuck rails.

regression_checks.check: Actual home-deals handler with a missing requested snapshot
Whole-site desktop and mobile route inspection
regression_checks.evidence: qa-reports/v597-local/public-inspection.json: 82 routes, zero script errors, zero overflow, zero stuck busy and zero stuck rails; local data-dependent failures are separately attributed to absent D1 tables.

remaining_unknowns: Production supplier-backed tab contents require post-deployment verification against the real D1 bindings.
authorization_boundary: User authorized repair, regression testing and public publication of all in-scope VII defects, excluding accessibility and typography audits.
